title: fix(metadata-protocol): land the sys_metadata ACTIVE overlay index on PostgreSQL
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_
Fixes #33901
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:PostgreSQL 上 `sys_metadata` 的 ACTIVE 覆盖层唯一键现在真正落成与 SQLite 相同的部分 NULL 安全唯一索引;启动时不再打印 2BP01 的 DATABASE_ERROR。
- 为什么改:原先 PostgreSQL 上留下的是声明的 NULL-distinct 唯一约束,`bundle_member` 几乎全为 NULL,等于没有约束,同一 (type, name, package) 可以有两条 ACTIVE 覆盖行,读取结果不确定。
- 风险与回滚:只改运行时索引迁移的调用方式(传入表名与方言,执行通道返回结果);已有重复 ACTIVE 行时保留旧约束、不删任何行,只打印 ADR-0120 D4 报告。回滚即 revert 本 PR,下次启动索引保持现状不会被破坏。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-overlay-index.ts`(执行通道改为返回结果并传 client,这是本修复的另一半);`packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/overlay-index.ts` 的 `ensureOverlayStateIndex`;`identity-index.live-postgres.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:在空 PostgreSQL 库上 `os dev -d postgres://…` 启动、登录后请求 `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts`,日志中 DATABASE_ERROR 为 0 行;`select indexdef from pg_indexes where indexname='idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active'` 显示 `COALESCE(package_id…), COALESCE(bundle_member…) WHERE state = 'active'`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ensureOverlayStateIndex` / `ensureMetadataOverlayIndexes` take `opts.client` and pass `table: sys_metadata` and that client to `probeThenReplaceIndex`. On PostgreSQL this selects the arm the `sys_setting` and `sys_notification_preference` identity migrations already take: it frees the constraint-held name with `ALTER TABLE … DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS`, builds the partial NULL-safe index, and answers `created` only when the definition reads back equal to the probe's.
- The boot call site (`protocol-overlay-index.ts`, `ensureOverlayIndex`) resolves the client name off the driver (`resolveDriverClientName`) and its raw-SQL seam now **returns** the statement's result. This half was needed as well: the seam used to discard every result, so with only table and client passed, the PostgreSQL read-back fails at `probe` on every boot. Measured below (ablation 3). The draft index, which lands today, would then stop landing too.
- Duplicate ACTIVE rows: the previous constraint stays, no row is deleted, and the existing ADR-0120 D4 `[metadata-protocol] cannot rebuild 'idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active'` line is printed. It names the unenforced key, the listing query and `os migrate duplicates`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, plus `@objectstack/rest` patch. `rest` lists metadata-protocol as a devDependency and its tsup build inlines it, so `rest/dist` ships its own copy of this migration. Measured: `grep -l idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active_probe` finds it in `packages/rest/dist/index.js` and `index.cjs`, and the rebuilt rest dist carries the fix.

## Tests

- `overlay-index.test.ts`: a new top-level describe, `the PostgreSQL arm is taken (constraint-held name)`. It runs in Test Core with no server, using a double that answers like PostgreSQL: a constraint-held name refuses `DROP INDEX`, `IF NOT EXISTS` on a held name is a no-op, and `pg_get_indexdef` reads back. Three cases: the migration lands the partial key with no error line; the boot call site resolves the client off the driver and hands the read-back its rows; and when the drop cannot free the name, the result is `failed` with the D4 "existing index is unchanged" line, never `created`.
- `identity-index.live-postgres.test.ts` (the existing live-PostgreSQL harness for this seam's callers, which the CI live step selects by its `live-postgres` substring): a new top-level describe, `sys_metadata overlay ACTIVE key on a LIVE PostgreSQL`. It drives `ensureOverlayIndex`, with a driver shaped like `SqlDriver` and the knex-compiled declared constraint as the fixture. Case 1: a fresh database ends with the partial index, `console.error`/`warn` are never called, a second ACTIVE row is refused with 23505, an ACTIVE+DRAFT pair is admitted, and a second boot is quiet and idempotent. Case 2: with duplicate ACTIVE rows the constraint stays, both rows survive, the draft index still lands, and exactly one D4 line names the key, the listing query and `os migrate duplicates`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored with blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

1. Caller passes no table/client (`overlay-index.ts`, the two option lines deleted): `Tests 4 failed | 37 passed (41)`. All three Test Core PG-arm cases go red (`expected [ …(10) ] to include 'ALTER TABLE sys_metadata DROP CONSTRA…'`, `expected 'created' to be 'failed'`), and so does live case 1 (`expected true to be false`: the constraint still holds).
2. The call site passes `{}` instead of the client: `Tests 2 failed | 39 passed (41)`. The call-site case and live case 1 go red.
3. The call-site seam discards the result again (`await resolved(sql)`): `Tests 3 failed | 38 passed (41)`. The error is `the read-back of 'idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active_probe' returned no result set`, and the draft probe fails the same way.
4. Drop without a replacement in the duplicate case (`partial-index-probe.ts`, the PostgreSQL arm frees the name when the probe fails): live case 2 goes red, `expected false to be true` at the constraint-holds assertion. The first attempt was a no-op: the replacement contained the anchor, so the tool refused it ("anchor count moved 1 -> 1"). It was re-run with a different anchor.
5. Duplicates silently deleted before the probe (`DELETE … USING …` injected into `ensureOverlayStateIndex`): live case 2 goes red, `expected false to be true`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The new pins live in the existing shared files as top-level describes, not in a new card-named file. AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846) requires this, and a live pin outside a `live-postgres` path would never be selected by the CI live step.
- `protocol-overlay-index.ts` is outside the claim's stated surface. The client can only be resolved at the call site, and the seam's discarded result blocks the read-back, so this file had to change for the ruling to hold.
- With duplicates present, the driver still prints its own `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR … (23505) … could not create unique index "idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active_probe"` line ahead of the D4 line. This happens on every dialect, comes from the probe, and predates this change.
- `ensureOverlayIndex` resolves its driver with `engine.driver ?? engine.getDriver()`, not `getDriverForObject('sys_metadata')` as the identity migrations do. On a kernel where platform objects sit on a non-default datasource, it could address the wrong connection. This is inferred from reading the code, not reproduced, so it is noted here and not filed.

## Verification

Real boots, `examples/app-todo` through `objectstack dev -d postgres://…`, against a private PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster:

<details><summary>Before (origin/main 895783a1e8, fresh database)</summary>

After sign-in and `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` (200), there is 1 line, `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR — the backend refused a raw statement (2BP01) … cannot drop index idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active because constraint idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active on table sys_metadata requires it`. `pg_indexes` shows `UNIQUE … (type, name, package_id, bundle_member)`, `pg_constraint` shows contype `u`, and no `[metadata-protocol]` line is printed.

</details>

<details><summary>After (this branch, fresh database)</summary>

0 DATABASE_ERROR lines. The `_active` index reads `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active ON public.sys_metadata USING btree (type, name, COALESCE(package_id, ''::character varying), COALESCE(bundle_member, ''::character varying)) WHERE ((state)::text = 'active'::text)`, and no constraint remains under the name. The `/meta` write doors keep their answers: `PUT /meta/view/todo_task.h4_probe` twice (200, active), `?mode=draft` twice beside the active row (200), `POST …/publish` (200), then `PUT` again (200). One active row results and no DATABASE_ERROR line is printed.

</details>

<details><summary>After, database already holding two ACTIVE rows of one key</summary>

The constraint stays (`u`), both rows survive, and one `[metadata-protocol] cannot rebuild 'idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active' on "sys_metadata" — existing rows violate (type, name, COALESCE(package_id, ''), COALESCE(bundle_member, '')) among state='active'. The previous index is left in place … List them with: SELECT … — or run "os migrate duplicates" — then restart (ADR-0120 D4).` line is printed.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates and tests</summary>

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` at merged head ed3bc40e99, with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set: `Test Files 347 passed | 4 skipped (351)`, `Tests 22931 passed | 19 skipped (22950)`; the 4 skipped files are the `live-mysql` ones, since no MySQL URL was set. `typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exits 0.
- `pnpm lint` (eslint . --no-inline-config) exits 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on this diff derived 63 commands. All 63 were run and each exit code was captured before any pipe: 62 exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no dist) on the first pass and 0 on the re-run after a full build: 123 entry points, 72 packages. `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- Direct dependents of metadata-protocol: the verify lock timed out (exit 99) on the first attempt, so these are NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI's Test Core. `@objectstack/rest` (which inlines this module) was then run: `Tests 4 failed | 8750 passed`. All 4 failures are in two test files that origin/main added in this merge (`aggregate-measure-filter-pushdown.test.ts`, `aggregation-filter-where-doors.test.ts`), each `TypeError: page.entries is not iterable`, read against an objectql dist not yet rebuilt after main's aggregate changes. They do not touch the overlay index. The re-run after rebuilding rest's closure is recorded in the report.

</details>
